SILT#00054: False cognates and false friends are two similar but distinct concepts. Both relate to words that look/sound alike, but false cognates are when the words have different etymologies (history), while, false friends occur when they have different meaning (definition)

## Additional Context

- <https://linguistics.stackexchange.com/questions/2612/whats-the-difference-between-a-false-cognate-and-a-false-friend#2613>
